name: Does your threat assessment include the motives, intent and capability of the threat actors relevant to your service?
conditionsText:
Applies when:
- Threat assessments are being performed.
- Threat modelling is underway.
- Security controls are being selected.
requirementTitle: Does your threat assessment include the motives, intent and capability of the threat actors relevant to your service?
requirementDescription:
Does your assessment explain:
- Who might attack the service?
- Why they would attack it?
- What they are trying to achieve?
- Whether they have the ability to succeed?
why:
Understanding attackers helps teams design proportionate security controls.
Secure by Design states that threat assessments should capture threat actor:
- Motivation
- Intent
- Capability
- Type of threat actor
